BiblicalUsage: Arba is named as the greatest man among the Anakim, the father of Anak, whose name the city of Hebron bore before it was Hebron. Kirjath-arba, the city of Arba, is where Sarah died and where Caleb was given his inheritance among the children of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Arba matters because his name is still on the city when the promise is fulfilled, and the greatest of the giants gives way to the inheritance of Caleb.
